zh.name: 常用單位換算
zh.description: 把長度、面積、質量、容量與溫度換成方便核對的單位。
zh.useCase: 輸入數值、選好兩端單位，即時查看換算結果與公式。

example.label: 換算範例
example.detail: 1 公尺等於 100 公分。

en.name: Unit Converter
en.description: Convert common units for length, area, mass, volume, and temperature.
en.useCase: Enter a value, choose both units, and read the result with its formula.

example.label: Worked example
example.detail: One metre equals 100 centimetres.

zh.name: 日期差與加減天數
zh.description: 計算兩個公曆日期相隔幾天，或從指定日期加減整數天數。
zh.useCase: 同時查看日期差，以及把起訖日都計入時的天數。

example.label: 計算範例
example.detail: 相隔 9 天；含起訖日共 10 天。

en.name: Date Difference and Day Calculator
en.description: Count days between Gregorian dates or add and subtract whole days from a date.
en.useCase: See the date difference alongside the count that includes both endpoints.

example.label: Worked example
example.detail: 9 days apart; 10 days including both dates.

zh.name: 專注計時器
zh.description: 設定 1 至 180 分鐘，在瀏覽器開始、暫停或繼續一段專注時間。
zh.useCase: 需要休息時保留剩餘時間，準備好後再繼續；不需要帳號或通知權限。

example.label: 專注範例
example.detail: 設定 25 分鐘閱讀；結束後自行決定下一段時間。

en.name: Focus Timer
en.description: Set 1 to 180 minutes and start, pause, or resume a focus session in your browser.
en.useCase: Keep the remaining time when you pause and resume when ready. No account or notification permission needed.

example.label: Focus example
example.detail: Set 25 minutes for reading, then choose when to start your next session.

zh.name: 配色與文字對比
zh.description: 整理 2 至 8 色色票，轉換 HEX、RGB、HSL，並檢查文字與背景的對比。
zh.useCase: 調整不透明 sRGB 色彩，查看 WCAG 文字對比門檻，再複製色碼或下載 CSS。

example.label: 對比範例
example.detail: 一般文字 AA 未通過；大字 AA 通過。結果只針對這兩個色彩。

en.name: Color Palette and Text Contrast
en.description: Arrange 2 to 8 colors, convert HEX, RGB and HSL, and check text and background contrast.
en.useCase: Edit opaque sRGB colors, review WCAG text contrast thresholds, then copy color codes or download CSS.

example.label: Contrast example
example.detail: Normal text AA fails; large text AA passes. Results apply only to these two colors.

zh.name: 文字整理與統計
zh.description: 整理每行首尾空格、空行與重複行，核對原文與結果的碼點、行數及 UTF-8 大小。
zh.useCase: 貼上清單、選擇整理方式，再複製結果或下載純文字檔。

example.label: 整理範例
example.detail: 移除重複行時保留第一次出現的順序，區分大小寫。

en.name: Text Cleaner and Counter
en.description: Trim line edges, remove empty or duplicate lines, and compare code points, lines and UTF-8 size.
en.useCase: Paste a list, choose your cleanup options, then copy the result or download a plain text file.

example.label: Cleanup example
example.detail: Removing duplicate lines keeps their first occurrence and remains case-sensitive.

zh.name: JSON 檢查與格式化
zh.description: 檢查 JSON 語法與重複鍵，格式化或壓縮內容，保留原始數字文字。
zh.useCase: 貼上 JSON，查看錯誤位置或取得整理後的結果。

example.label: 使用範例
example.detail: 長整數、負零與科學記號保留原始寫法。

en.name: JSON Validator and Formatter
en.description: Check JSON syntax and duplicate keys, format or minify content, and preserve original number tokens.
en.useCase: Paste JSON to locate errors or get a formatted result.

example.label: Example
example.detail: Large integers, negative zero and scientific notation keep their original spelling.

zh.name: 逐行文字差異比較
zh.description: 比較兩段文字，逐行標示新增、刪除與相同行，保留尾端空行。
zh.useCase: 把兩個版本並排貼上，核對差異或下載比較報告。

example.label: 使用範例
example.detail: 逐行顯示移除與新增；不自動合併文字。

en.name: Line-by-Line Text Diff
en.description: Compare two texts with added, removed and unchanged lines, including trailing empty lines.
en.useCase: Paste both versions to review changes or download a comparison report.

example.label: Example
example.detail: Review removals and additions without automatic merging.

zh.name: CSV 檢視與欄位整理
zh.description: 在瀏覽器預覽 UTF-8 CSV，選取欄位，匯出 CSV 或 JSON。
zh.useCase: 保留文字型數值；遇到試算表公式風險時，確認後才匯出保護副本。

example.label: 使用範例
example.detail: 前導零保持為字串；保護副本會改寫公式風險欄位。

en.name: CSV Viewer and Column Export
en.description: Preview UTF-8 CSV in your browser, select columns, and export CSV or JSON.
en.useCase: Keep text values intact and confirm a protected copy when spreadsheet formula risks are detected.

example.label: Example
example.detail: Leading zeros remain strings; protected copies modify formula-risk cells.

zh.name: 權重決策矩陣
zh.description: 列出方案與準則，設定權重與效益或成本方向，再比較加權分數。
zh.useCase: 核對自己的取捨；缺少必要評分或總權重為零時不顯示排名。

example.label: 使用範例
example.detail: 分數反映你的輸入，不代表客觀最佳答案。

en.name: Weighted Decision Matrix
en.description: List options and criteria, set weights and benefit or cost directions, then compare weighted scores.
en.useCase: Review your trade-offs. Missing required scores or zero total weight prevent ranking.

example.label: Example
example.detail: Scores reflect your inputs, not an objectively best answer.

zh.name: 圖片縮放與匯出
zh.description: 選取單張靜態 PNG 或 JPEG，等比例縮小後匯出圖片。
zh.useCase: 設定寬、高或最長邊，預覽實際結果後下載 PNG、JPEG 或支援的 WebP。

example.label: 使用範例
example.detail: 保持比例、不放大；修改設定會讓舊結果失效。

en.name: Image Resizer and Export
en.description: Choose one static PNG or JPEG and reduce its dimensions while keeping proportions.
en.useCase: Set width, height or longest edge, then inspect and download PNG, JPEG or supported WebP output.

example.label: Example
example.detail: Proportions stay locked without enlargement. Changed settings invalidate old results.

zh.name: 網址參數檢視與整理
zh.description: 檢視、編輯與選擇移除網址參數，不開啟輸入連結。
zh.useCase: 保留未修改的編碼與重複參數，產生可自行複製的新網址。

example.label: 範例
example.detail: 選擇移除 utm_source，保留 tag 的兩個值及順序。

en.name: URL Inspector & Query Editor
en.description: Inspect, edit, and selectively remove query parameters without opening the link.
en.useCase: Preserve untouched encoding and duplicate parameters while creating a URL to copy.

example.label: Example
example.detail: Remove utm_source while keeping both tag values in their original order.

zh.name: 分帳與墊款結算
zh.description: 填入每人的已付金額，算出誰付給誰多少；另有進階分帳。
zh.useCase: 聚餐或旅行各自墊款，未付款的人填 0，一次列出結算清單。

example.label: 計算範例
example.detail: 三人各分攤 400；乙給甲 100，丙給甲 400。

en.name: Bill Splitter & Settlement Calculator
en.description: Enter what each person paid to see who owes whom, with advanced bill splitting available.
en.useCase: Settle shared meals or trips: enter each person's payments, including 0, and get a transfer list.

example.label: Worked example
example.detail: Each person owes 400. Bob pays Alice 100; Charlie pays Alice 400.

zh.name: 檔案 SHA-256 校驗
zh.description: 在瀏覽器本機計算檔案 SHA-256，核對下載或交付檔案的校驗碼。
zh.useCase: 選擇單一檔案、貼上預期碼比較，複製或下載校驗碼；檔案不會上傳。

example.label: 規格範例
example.detail: 接受空檔與最多128 MiB單檔；比對校驗碼不是安全掃描，仍須信任預期碼來源。

en.name: File SHA-256 Checksum
en.description: Calculate a file SHA-256 locally in your browser and compare a download or delivery checksum.
en.useCase: Choose one file, compare an expected hash, and copy or download the checksum without uploading the file.

example.label: Planned example
example.detail: Supports empty files and one file up to 128 MiB. A match is not a security scan.

zh.name: 購物單價比較
zh.description: 輸入整組價格、每包容量與包數，比較同一基準的商品單價。
zh.useCase: 比較大小包或多入組，辨認最低單價。

example.label: 使用範例
example.detail: 每100g分別12與10；後者單價較低。

en.name: Unit Price Comparison
en.description: Compare package prices, sizes and pack counts on the same unit basis.
en.useCase: Compare different package sizes and multipacks to find the lowest unit price.

example.label: Example
example.detail: Per 100g: 12 versus 10. The second option has the lower unit price.

zh.name: 名單隨機分組
zh.description: 貼上一人一行的名單，產生人數均衡且保留同名者的分組。
zh.useCase: 課堂或活動要分組，檢查完整成員後複製分享。

example.label: 使用範例
example.detail: 各組3人與2人，每位參與者只出現一次。

en.name: Random Group Generator
en.description: Paste one person per line to create balanced groups while keeping duplicate names distinct.
en.useCase: Split a class or event roster, review every member, then copy the groups.

example.label: Example
example.detail: Group sizes are 3 and 2; each participant appears once.

zh.name: 工時加總
zh.description: 輸入多段開始、結束與休息時間，取得每日與整批工時。
zh.useCase: 整理零散工作時段，處理跨日並避免重疊重複計入。

example.label: 使用範例
example.detail: 休息均0：總共7小時30分，十進位為7.50小時。

en.name: Work Hours Calculator
en.description: Enter work intervals and breaks to get daily and overall hours.
en.useCase: Add separate work intervals, handle overnight shifts and avoid counting overlaps twice.

example.label: Example
example.detail: With no breaks: 7 hours 30 minutes, or 7.50 decimal hours.

zh.name: 名單比對與合併
zh.description: 比對兩份逐行名單，找出共同項目、各自獨有項目與合併清單。
zh.useCase: 核對報名、邀請或工作清單，明確選擇空白與大小寫規則。

example.label: 使用範例
example.detail: 交集為乙；合併依序為甲、乙、丙。

en.name: List Comparison and Merge
en.description: Compare two line-based lists to find shared entries, differences and a merged list.
en.useCase: Reconcile rosters and task lists with explicit whitespace and case rules.

example.label: Example
example.value: A: Alex, Blair; B: Blair, Casey
example.detail: Shared: Blair. Merge: Alex, Blair, Casey.

zh.name: 食譜份量換算
zh.description: 依原份數和目標份數換算食材數量，保留原單位與適量項目。
zh.useCase: 做菜人數改變時，一次換算整份食材表。

example.label: 規格範例
example.detail: 米改為450g；不推測烹調時間或溫度。

en.name: Recipe Portion Scaler
en.description: Scale ingredient amounts to a new portion count while keeping units and to-taste items.
en.useCase: Adjust an ingredient list when cooking for more or fewer people.

example.label: Planned example
example.detail: Use 450g rice. Cooking time and temperature are not inferred.

zh.name: 折扣與免運試算
zh.description: 比較原購物籃和加買方案的最終實付，依自填折扣與免運規則試算。
zh.useCase: 判斷為了湊免運加買商品後，究竟多付或少付多少。

example.label: 規格範例
example.detail: 原實付980，加買後1000，實際多花20。

en.name: Discount and Free Shipping Check
en.description: Compare final cart totals before and after an extra purchase using your discount and shipping rules.
en.useCase: See whether buying extra for free shipping actually lowers the final payment.

example.label: Planned example
example.value: 900 plus 80 shipping; add 100 for free shipping
example.detail: Pay 980 originally or 1000 after adding items: 20 more.

zh.name: 行李清單與重量試算
zh.description: 整理待打包物品、件數與重量，檢查自訂上限並匯出本機備份。
zh.useCase: 出門前查看漏帶項目及已知重量；未填重量會清楚標示。

example.label: 規格範例
example.detail: 已知重量1200g；有未知重量時不能宣稱未超限。

en.name: Packing List and Weight Check
en.description: Track packing items, quantities and weights against your own limit, with local backups.
en.useCase: Find unpacked items and known weight, with missing weights shown explicitly.

example.label: Planned example
example.detail: Known weight is 1200g. Missing weights prevent an all-clear limit verdict.

zh.name: 文字分段與字數限制
zh.description: 依自訂Unicode碼點上限切分長文，保留原始內容並逐段複製。
zh.useCase: 把長文拆成容易貼上的片段；不假設各平台的計字規則。

example.label: 規格範例
example.detail: 得到AB、CD、E；串接後仍是原文。

en.name: Text Chunking by Length
en.description: Split text by a custom Unicode code-point limit, preserving the source for per-chunk copying.
en.useCase: Prepare smaller text pieces for pasting without assuming a platform's counting rules.

example.label: Planned example
example.value: ABCDE, with a limit of 2 code points
example.detail: Produces AB, CD and E. Joining them preserves the original text.

zh.name: 自訂文字遮蔽
zh.description: 在本機將明確指定的字串替換為遮蔽標記，檢查後複製或下載。
zh.useCase: 分享文字前遮蔽已知內容；不自動辨識所有個人資料。

example.label: 規格範例
example.detail: 結果為[REDACTED] [REDACTED]，較長匹配優先。

en.name: Custom Text Redaction
en.description: Locally replace explicitly selected strings with a redaction marker, then review and copy or download.
en.useCase: Hide known text before sharing; this does not automatically detect all personal data.

example.label: Planned example
example.value: Anna Ann; targets Anna and Ann
example.detail: Produces [REDACTED] [REDACTED], preferring the longer match.
